pages.text: Unlike most armors that can be made from resources found in the world, the Sinner's Robe that can be made from Risus-related materials holds far more potential. On top of decent defensive abilities and a health boosting capability, each piece of the set can have its own 'Unique Ability'. These can vary greatly: from increased stealth against certain creatures; to the ability to walk on darkness.

Making the pieces of the Sinner's Robe is an involved process. First, a full set of $(l:armors/skin_armor)$(c)$(o)Skin Armor$() is needed. After that, four $(l:materials/gluttonous_scales)$(c)$(o)Gluttony Scales$() are used for each piece, totaling sixteen. Finally, one Stitching Needle is required per piece.
This armor can be dyed and trimmed. These aesthetic effects will appear alongside the abilities' visuals.
A Cauldron of Water will remove the dye applied, while a Cauldron of Lava will remove the ability.
